name: Alex Rivera
knowsAbout: custom fire pits and fire features
description:
Alex Rivera is a luxury outdoor design and construction specialist focused on creating refined, highly personalized exterior environments for Pasadena estate homes and discerning Southern California homeowners. With more than 15 years of experience in high-end outdoor living, Alex approaches every project as more than a pool, patio, or landscape installation—he sees it as an opportunity to transform a property into a complete, cohesive lifestyle experience.

His work centers on the thoughtful integration of architecture, landscape, water, stone, fire, lighting, and outdoor living. Alex specializes in custom swimming pools, infinity-edge and resort-style pool environments, integrated spas, premium hardscaping, natural stonework, outdoor kitchens, fire features, drought-tolerant landscaping, and sophisticated entertaining spaces. Whether designing a sleek contemporary backyard or a layered, resort-inspired retreat, he focuses on ensuring every element feels intentional, balanced, and connected to the character of the home.

Known for his detail-oriented approach, Alex works closely with clients to understand how they live, entertain, relax, and envision using their outdoor space. He translates those preferences into tailored design solutions that improve functionality, enhance property value, and create a seamless transition between the interior of the home and the surrounding landscape. The result is an outdoor environment that feels polished, livable, and uniquely suited to the homeowner—not a one-size-fits-all backyard.

Alex also brings a practical construction perspective to complex outdoor projects. He understands the importance of coordinating multiple phases of work, including design planning, pool construction, excavation, hardscaping, landscaping, lighting, outdoor kitchens, and final finishing details. By keeping the complete project vision in focus from concept through installation, he helps clients avoid the fragmented process of managing separate vendors for every part of a luxury backyard renovation.

His design philosophy combines modern aesthetics with enduring craftsmanship and California-conscious landscaping. Alex incorporates water-wise, drought-tolerant, and California-native plant palettes where appropriate, pairing sustainability with premium materials, architectural detail, and a sophisticated luxury finish. His goal is to create outdoor spaces that are as responsible and practical as they are visually striking.

For homeowners seeking a custom pool, elevated outdoor entertaining space, or full estate-level backyard transformation, Alex Rivera provides a collaborative, design-driven approach grounded in craftsmanship, careful planning, and meticulous attention to the client’s vision.
